# ChatLegal docs

> UK citizen legal-information pages for chatlegal.uk. Not a solicitor. Not legal advice.

Five evaluation leaves are draft copy from the gold notes. They are not counsel-reviewed. Other pages are still placeholders.

Source: https://github.com/metaspan/chatlegal

## Overview

- [Overview](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/): Start here. Five evaluation pages are draft information. The other pages are still placeholders. Not legal advice.
- [How it works](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/how-it-works/): Placeholder for protocols, triage, citations, and jurisdiction tags for England and Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland.

## Law

- [Housing](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/): Draft hub for housing in England and Wales. Possession notices and deposits are in the evaluation set. Not legal advice.
- [Possession notice](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/possession-notice/): Draft information on possession notices in England after 1 May 2026. Not a verdict on any notice.
- [Deposit](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/deposit/): Draft information on tenancy deposit protection in England. No award is calculated.
- [Disrepair](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/disrepair/): Planned stub for housing disrepair. Not written yet.
- [Rent increase](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/rent-increase/): Planned stub for rent increases. Not written yet.
- [Illegal eviction](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/illegal-eviction/): Planned stub. Illegal eviction is marked for a hard-escalate callout. This page does not explain the law.
- [Neighbour nuisance](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/neighbour-nuisance/): Planned stub for neighbour nuisance. Not written yet.
- [Boundary](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/housing/boundary/): Planned stub for boundary problems. Not written yet.
- [Employment](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/employment/): Draft hub for employment in England and Wales. Unpaid wages are in the evaluation set. Not legal advice.
- [Unpaid wages](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/employment/unpaid-wages/): Draft information on unpaid wages and the Acas clock. No deadline is calculated.
- [Dismissal](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/employment/dismissal/): Planned stub for dismissal. Not written yet.
- [Redundancy](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/employment/redundancy/): Planned stub for redundancy. Not written yet.
- [Harassment and discrimination](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/employment/harassment-discrimination/): Planned stub for harassment and discrimination at work. Not written yet.
- [Holiday and sick pay](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/employment/holiday-sick-pay/): Planned stub for holiday and sick pay. Not written yet.
- [Consumer / debt](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/consumer/): Draft hub for consumer and debt topics in England and Wales. Private parking is in the evaluation set.
- [Private parking](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/consumer/private-parking/): Draft information on private parking charges in England and Wales. Not a decision on whether to pay.
- [Council PCN](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/consumer/council-pcn/): Planned stub for council PCNs. Not written yet.
- [Faulty goods](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/consumer/faulty-goods/): Planned stub for faulty goods. Not written yet.
- [Bailiffs](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/consumer/bailiffs/): Planned stub for bailiffs. Not written yet.
- [Credit complaints](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/consumer/credit-complaints/): Planned stub for credit complaints. Not written yet.
- [Welfare](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/welfare/): Draft hub for welfare in England. Universal Credit sanctions are in the evaluation set. Not legal advice.
- [Universal Credit sanction](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/welfare/uc-sanction-mr/): Draft information on Universal Credit sanctions and mandatory reconsideration. No outcome is predicted.
- [PIP refusal](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/welfare/pip-refusal/): Planned stub for PIP refusals. Not written yet.
- [Tribunal appeal](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/welfare/tribunal-appeal/): Planned stub for benefit tribunal appeals. Not written yet.
- [Overpayment](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/welfare/overpayment/): Planned stub for benefit overpayments. Not written yet.

## Sources

- [Sources](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/sources/): Placeholder hub for data sources. Allowlist tables are not generated in this milestone.
- [Legislation](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/sources/legislation/): Placeholder for legislation.gov.uk and related Open Government Licence text. No statute is quoted here.
- [GOV.UK and Acas](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/sources/govuk-acas/): Placeholder for GOV.UK, Acas, and related official guidance sources. No guidance is quoted here.
- [Find Case Law](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/sources/find-case-law/): Placeholder for Find Case Law licence notes. Judgment text is not shown.
- [Courts and tribunals](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/sources/courts-tribunals/): Placeholder for court and tribunal source notes. Decisions are not reproduced here.
- [Link-out only](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/sources/link-out-only/): Placeholder for sources that stay link-out only. This site does not link to the Official Injury Claim service and does not quote blocked sources.
- [Attribution](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/sources/attribution/): Placeholder for the attribution lines the site will use when it later quotes official text. Nothing is quoted in this scaffold.

## Help

- [Referrals](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/referrals/): Placeholder for where to get help from a person. Routes are not listed yet. This page is not a helpline.

## Governance

- [Policies](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/policies/): Placeholder index of draft policy notes in the ChatLegal repository. Summaries are not written yet.
- [For agents](https://chatlegal.uk/docs/for-agents/): Machine-readable stub index at /llms.txt. Citation rules are not written yet.
